info.title: LMS AI Tutor Service
info.description: A course-grounded tutor and support assistant: retrieval over the course's own content with citations, a hint ladder for practice problems, disabled inside graded tests, escalation to support tickets, a curated FAQ and offline retrieval evaluation. Calls ai-gateway for every model and embedding.

post.description: Send an `Idempotency-Key`: a retry returns the same answer instead of asking twice. `stream: true` answers with `application/x-ndjson`: a `start` line, `delta` lines, then a final `message` line (or an `error` line). Refused with `403 TUTOR_DISABLED_IN_TEST` while a graded test is in progress. Errors that would normally be HTTP errors are still HTTP errors when streaming: they are raised before the stream starts.

FaqPromote.title: FaqPromote
FaqPromote.description:
Turn a tutor answer into a draft FAQ entry: the student's question and the answer become the starting text, to be
edited (in particular, stripped of anything personal) before it is published.
